crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of…
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,
Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?

translations.web: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
translations.bsb: You must use honest scales, a just ephah, and a just bath.
translations.kjv: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
translations.asv: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
